hero.headline: Clearance and house clearances in Munich — fast, clean, fairly priced.
hero.subheadline: Apartments, houses, cellars, attics and offices — cleared professionally, disposed of responsibly, handed over broom-clean.

items.title: Flat clearance
items.body: From a one-room flat to a detached house, including cellar, attic and balcony. We clear completely, sort by material as we carry out and hand over broom-clean. Mark anything you want to keep — labelled items are left untouched.

items.title: House clearances
items.body: The complete clearance of a household, for example after a bereavement or a move into care. We work discreetly, document finds such as documents, jewellery or cash and hand them to you. On request we handle everything without you being present — a key handover is enough.

items.title: Cellar, attic and garage
items.body: Including hard-to-reach, low or densely packed spaces. These areas are the most commonly overlooked in cost estimates and the main cause of follow-up charges — we record them explicitly during the survey.

items.title: Office and commercial clearance
items.body: Office furniture, IT equipment, stock and shop fittings. GDPR-compliant document destruction with a certificate on request, electrical appliances via approved take-back schemes. Outside business hours if you prefer.

items.title: Disposal, recycling and value offset
items.body: Sorted into bulky waste, wood, metal, paper, electrical appliances and hazardous waste. Usable items go to reuse rather than incineration. Good furniture, appliances, antiques and metals are offset against your final price. Disposal documentation on request.

items.title: Broom-clean handover
items.body: Fully cleared, swept, free of waste and personal belongings, cupboards and floors empty. On request we add a deep clean including windows and sanitary fittings, or the cosmetic repairs, so the flat is handed over in contractual condition.

steps.title: Inspection

steps.title: Fixed-price quote
steps.body: You receive a transparent quote with no hidden costs.

steps.title: Scheduling
steps.body: We agree on a date that suits you.

steps.title: Execution

steps.title: Broom-clean handover

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions about clearance in Munich

items.question: What does a clearance in Munich cost?
items.answer: Typical market rates are €35–70 per square metre. A 60 m² flat therefore runs about €1,800–3,500, a cellar unit from around €300, a detached house €4,500–9,000. After a short survey you receive a fixed price including disposal.

items.question: How long does a clearance take?
items.answer: A cellar or garage is usually cleared in three to five hours, a two- to three-room flat in a working day, a detached house in two to four days. Volume, floor level and access decide.

items.question: Are disposal fees included in the price?
items.answer: Yes. Our fixed price covers containers, landfill fees, crew, travel and the broom-clean handover. We do not add disposal charges afterwards.

items.question: What happens to usable furniture and items?
items.answer: We sort by material and pass usable items to reuse rather than disposal. Resalable items such as good furniture, appliances or antiques are offset against your price.

items.question: Do you handle house clearances after a bereavement?
items.answer: Yes. We know this is a sensitive matter and work discreetly. Documents, jewellery and cash are documented and handed to you. On request we handle everything without you being present.

items.question: Do I have to be there during the clearance?
items.answer: No. After the survey and a clear agreement on what stays and what goes, a key handover is enough. Many relatives who do not live in Munich handle the whole clearance remotely.

items.question: Is the flat really broom-clean afterwards?
items.answer: Yes — broom-clean is part of our standard process: fully cleared, swept, cupboards and floors empty. A deeper clean including windows and sanitary fittings is arranged separately.

items.question: Do you dispose of hazardous waste and electrical appliances?
items.answer: Yes. Paints, varnishes, oils, chemicals and fluorescent tubes go to approved disposal routes, electrical appliances through the mandatory take-back scheme. Where asbestos is suspected we work exclusively with certified specialists.

lead: SuperEntrümpelung clears flats, houses, cellars, attics and commercial space in Munich and the surrounding area — at a fixed price after a short survey. Typical market rates run €35–70 per square metre. We sort by material, dispose with documented proof and hand the space over broom-clean.

pricing.headline: What a clearance in Munich costs
pricing.intro: We charge by actual volume in cubic metres and labour, not by floor area alone. The per-square-metre figure is a rough guide: a packed attic can cost more than an emptied flat of the same size.
extras: Surcharge per floor without a lift: 8–15 %
Deep clean beyond broom-clean: €3 – 8 per m²
Value offset for resalable furniture: reduces the price
pricing.note: All figures are typical market rates for Munich and the surrounding area, not offers. You receive your binding fixed price after a short survey on site or by photo and video.

items.body: The classic starting point: years of accumulated contents, gone in a few hours.

items.title: Hoarded and neglected flats
items.body: With protective equipment, a larger crew and disinfection on request. We work without judgement and without drawing attention.

entity.headline: About mmoving.de
entity.body: mmoving.de is the shared presence of three brands serving Munich and the surrounding area: SuperUmzug for moving, SuperEntrümpelung for clearance and house clearances, and BayReno for renovation and refurbishment. All three work under one coordination — one contact, one schedule, one contract, even when two or three trades come together. Active in Munich and within roughly 50 km, operating since [SEIT JAHR]. Advice available in German and English.
